description.en: In this collection we publish the Danish agricultural data sets integrated with the central company registry (CVR) data and make it available to the public via SPARQL endpoint. This integration makes it possible to query across this data. The endpoint is hosted on OpenLink Virtuoso. The original open data sets are provided from: [Central Business Registry of Denmark (CVR)](http://cvr.dk/ "cvr.dk"), [The Danish Ministry of the Environment](http://gst.dk/ "gst.dk"), [The Ministry of Food, Agriculture, and Fisheries of Denmark](http://fvm.dk/ "fvm.dk").

other_download.title: Agricultural Data
other_download.description: This dataset contains agricultural data of Denmark. We have three agricultural datasets; Field, Field Block, Organic Field converted into RDF+N3 format.

other_download.title: Business Data
other_download.description: This data set publish information about businesses incorporating in agriculture containing companies, addresses, production units and fully responsible participants of each business.

other_download.title: Agriculture Ontology
other_download.description:
This file contains the ontology developed for Danish agricultural linked data. 
Ontology is defined by re-using predicates from common vocabularies i.e. agrovoc, geonames, dbpedia (categories), etc.

other_download.title: Business Ontology
other_download.description: This file contains the ontology developed for Danish business data sets. Ontology is defined by re-using predicates from common vocabularies i.e. geonames, dbpedia, foaf , time, etc.

other_download.title: Agriculture and Business Ontology
other_download.description: The complete ontology developed for Danish agricultural and business linked data. Ontology is defined by re-using predicates from common vocabularies i.e. agrovoc, geonames, dbpedia (categories), foaf , time, etc.

other_download.title: govagribus-denmark
other_download.description:
This file contains RDF triples of complete govagribus-denmark data. Agricultural and business data is linked in this data set by using  
together agricultural and business ontologies (govagribus-denmark_ontology.owl) and other relevant external vocabularies. It also includes existing links to the external datasets.

sparql.description: Danish Governmental Agricultural Data SPARQL endpoint
